title: Retract transfer for filtered cover
statement: Let $k$ be algebraically closed [def-weil-algebraic-closure], $X$ a reduced [def-pc-reduced-scheme] separated finite-type $k$-curve of dimension at most one [def-weil-pbc-curve-setting], $j:U\to X$ an open immersion, $r$ a prime, $R=\operatorname{ULift}(\mathbb Z/r\mathbb Z)$, and $G$ a finite locally constant $R$-module sheaf [def-weil-pbc-etale-constructible-sheaf] on $U$. Let $v:V\to U$ be finite etale and $H=v_*v^*G$ [def-weil-pbc-direct-image, def-weil-pbc-inverse-image]. Assume all eight assertions [def-weil-pbc-eight-curve-assertions] hold for $j_!H$ [def-weil-pbc-extension-by-zero]. Suppose $\rho:H\to G$ retracts the adjunction unit $G\to H$. Then all eight assertions hold for $j_!G$.

proof.text: Apply extension by zero and then the forgetful sheaf functor to the supplied unit and retraction. Functor.map_comp and Functor.map_id give a composite equal to the identity. This is the retraction of underlying abelian sheaves used below.

Use v1-finite-cover-lower-shriek-coefficient-compatibility to obtain constructibility of the larger sheaf and transfer of invertible-order and primary torsion hypotheses. This step contains no cohomology descent.

For each q, Sheaf.H.map_comp_apply and Sheaf.H.map_id_apply give a left inverse to the cohomology map of the section. Thus it is injective. C1, C2, C3 descend via Function.Injective.subsingleton; C4 and C5 descend via Finite.of_injective. For C3 and C4 use precisely the transferred coefficient hypotheses of the preceding step.

For every scheme morphism t, cohomologyMap_map gives the naturality square for both retraction maps. Applying upperStar preserves their composite identity. To lift y along the smaller comparison map, lift the image of y under the pulled-back section along the larger comparison map, and apply the original cohomology retraction. Naturality and the pulled-back identity prove this is a lift. For injectivity, apply the pulled-back section to equality of smaller comparison images, use naturality and injectivity of the larger comparison map, then injectivity of the original section. These explicit private helper proofs descend C6, C7, and C8; combine the eight fields into Assertions.
